text: Today I received dental services at the Market Village branch, and the dental work was very unclean. I brought my family for teeth cleaning and a check-up. The dentist was very rushed, I don't know why they were in such a hurry. During the procedure, water was splashing everywhere, making everything wet. It was very unprofessional. In the end, we had to book another clinic for further treatment, paying twice because it was so unclean. I will definitely not go back there again. I hope you will improve your service. I paid for the service, but it wasn't worth the money. I don't mind paying more, but I want good, clean service. I'm very disappointed. However, the receptionist was very nice.
